jobs.title: Campus Safety & Security Officer
jobs.description:
University of North Texas System seeks a Police Officer to provide law enforcement, security, and public safety services across university properties and the campus community.

The role requires a high school diploma or GED, being at least 21, and physical ability to perform officer duties, with the capacity to work varied shifts and respond to emergencies. Strong ethics, judgment and communication are essential.

jobs.title: Campus Security Officer (Level III) — Visible Safety Leader
jobs.description:
Valorforces in Richardson, TX is seeking professional, disciplined Level III Commissioned Security Officers to support school-based safety and protection. This role emphasizes appearance, communication, and tactical readiness in a mission-driven environment.

As a commissioned officer on a school campus, you will patrol interior and exterior areas, respond to incidents, maintain de-escalation standards, and report daily activities to school admins and law enforcement.

jobs.description: A public university in Texas is seeking a Police Officer II to ensure safety on campus. Responsibilities include preventive patrol, investigating criminal activities, and enforcing laws. Candidates should be at least 20.5 years old, possess a high school diploma or GED, and have an active peace officer license. The role requires good judgment and effective communication skills. The position involves rotating shifts, providing law enforcement, and maintaining order in the community.

jobs.title: Campus Safety & Security Officer — Flexible Shifts
jobs.description: Irving ISD seeks a Campus Auxiliary Officer to ensure the security of students and property. The role involves patrolling the campus, monitoring activities, and maintaining safety protocols. Candidates should have a high school diploma, valid driver's license, and live within the Irving, Texas area. Effective communication skills in English and Spanish are preferred. The position offers a supportive environment with a focus on safety and student interactions.
